findings.title: Three Palestinians killed in Israeli airstrikes across Gaza City
findings.source_publication_local_time: 14:11 (WAFA display, 11 November 2026; displayed time zone not explicit)
findings.location: Sheikh Radwan, north Gaza City, and other areas of Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: WAFA says two people were killed and others injured in an Israeli strike on a tent sheltering displaced people in Sheikh Radwan; medical sources say three killed across Gaza City on Wednesday morning. Civilian/combatant status and identities unverified; whether the victims were displaced residents not independently established.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Medical sources said three Palestinians had been killed in Israeli airstrikes targeting several areas across Gaza City since this morning.
